summary: Iteration 21 testing of 'J'ai besoin d'aide' feature + Teams webhook + per-exam/default help recipients + updated page title. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass covering (a) complete student→teacher help flow (POST 201 with correct recipients list, 409 duplicate, GET /student/session.help_pending populated, PUT handle clears help_pending, DELETE cancels), (b) recipient isolation (second teacher created via /admin/users does not see other-exam help requests until added via /admin/exams/{id}/help-recipients; admin sees all), (c) teams_webhook validation (http:// → 400, valid https ≥30 chars → 200 teams_configured true, GET /auth/me never returns teams_webhook, POST /auth/me/teams-test → 502 for invalid host, empty string clears), (d) GET /api/teachers exposes teams_configured and never raw webhook, (e) help request still succeeds even with invalid webhook configured — teams_sent stays []. Frontend UI: page title 'MonExamEnLigne — Collège Champagneur' confirmed; teacher-login-link visible on homepage; HelpBell shows help-bell-count badge (2 open requests), help-bell-panel opens; profile dialog opens teams-settings (teams-webhook-input/save/remove/toggle/steps all work, status toggles between 'Non configuré' and '✓ Teams configuré'); student exam page shows help-request-btn → opens help-dialog with help-reason-1 chips → help-send-btn creates request and switches to help-pending-btn with success toast; admin Comptes/tab-aide exposes help-settings with 14 help-default-* checkboxes, help-default-save-btn, help-exam-0 with 12 help-exam-0-rcpt-{id} entries and conditional help-exam-save-0; ExamBuilder tab 1 shows help-recipients-section listing colleagues with persistent checked state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1328 lines — splitting into routers (help, teams, admin_help) would improve maintainability but is non-blocking.

notify_help_teams runs via asyncio.create_task without logging per-recipient result; invalid webhooks silently fail. Consider persisting failure reason on help_requests.teams_sent entries for admin troubleshooting.

ProfileIn validates webhook with `url.startswith('https://') and len(url) > 30` — accepts any https URL ≥31 chars. Consider validating host matches Microsoft Teams webhook domains (outlook.office.com, *.logic.azure.com, *.powerautomate.com).

GET /api/teachers returns ALL active users including admins — frontend RecipientsPicker filters by excludeId only, so admins appear in surveillant lists. Acceptable but worth confirming product intent.
